command:
mkdir -p /var/lib/file-integrity
cat > /usr/local/sbin/etc-integrity.sh <<'SCRIPT_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
# Generate or verify a SHA-256 + metadata baseline for /etc
set -eu

BASE_DIR=/var/lib/file-integrity
MANIFEST="$BASE_DIR/etc-baseline.sha256"
METADATA="$BASE_DIR/etc-baseline.meta"
LOG="$BASE_DIR/etc-integrity.log"

mode="${1:-verify}"

generate() {
    mkdir -p "$BASE_DIR"
    ( cd /etc && find . -xdev -type f | sort ) > "$BASE_DIR/.filelist"
    ( cd /etc && xargs -a "$BASE_DIR/.filelist" sha256sum ) > "$MANIFEST.tmp"
    mv "$MANIFEST.tmp" "$MANIFEST"
    ( cd /etc && find . -xdev \( -type f -o -type d -o -type l \) -printf '%y %m %U %G %s %T@ %p\n' | sort -k7 ) > "$METADATA.tmp"
    mv "$METADATA.tmp" "$METADATA"
    rm -f "$BASE_DIR/.filelist"
    printf '%s baseline generated: %s files\n' "$(date -Iseconds)" "$(wc -l < "$MANIFEST")" >> "$LOG"
    echo "Baseline written to $MANIFEST and $METADATA"
}

verify() {
    if [ ! -f "$MANIFEST" ]; then
        echo "No baseline found at $MANIFEST. Run: $0 generate" >&2
        exit 2
    fi
    cd /etc
    echo "=== Checksum differences (modified/missing tracked files) ==="
    sha256sum -c "$MANIFEST" 2>&1 | grep -v ': OK$' || echo "(none)"
    echo "=== New files not in baseline ==="
    find . -xdev -type f | sort > "$BASE_DIR/.filelist.now"
    awk '{print $2}' "$MANIFEST" | sed 's#^#./#' > "$BASE_DIR/.filelist.baseline"
    comm -13 "$BASE_DIR/.filelist.baseline" "$BASE_DIR/.filelist.now" || true
    rm -f "$BASE_DIR/.filelist.now" "$BASE_DIR/.filelist.baseline"
    printf '%s verify run\n' "$(date -Iseconds)" >> "$LOG"
}

case "$mode" in
    generate) generate ;;
    verify) verify ;;
    *) echo "Usage: $0 {generate|verify}" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
SCRIPT_EOF
